problems.quote: adopting the halegannada script reforms that replaced the archaic talakattu with the modern vatteluttu ‑derived forms
problems.problem: Kannada script is not derived from vatteluttu (a Tamil script); it evolved from the Kadamba script.
problems.correction: adopting the halegannada script reforms that replaced the archaic talakattu with the modern Kadamba‑derived forms
problems.verifierReason: Original wrongly attributes modern Kannada forms to Tamil vatteluttu; they derive from Kadamba script.

problems.quote: commissioned the Kannada‑English Dictionary (1919) edited by Ferdinand Kittel
problems.problem: Ferdinand Kittel died in 1903; his dictionary was first published in 1894. He could not have edited a 1919 edition.
problems.correction: commissioned the Kannada‑English Dictionary (1894) compiled by Ferdinand Kittel
problems.verifierReason: Kittel died 1903; his dictionary published 1894, not 1919. Correction fixes date and role.

problems.quote: The 1963 Karnataka Official Language Act reinforced Kannada’s primacy in state legislation
problems.problem: The state was named Mysore until 1973; the 1963 act was the Mysore Official Language Act.
problems.correction: The 1963 Mysore Official Language Act reinforced Kannada’s primacy in state legislation
problems.verifierReason: State was Mysore until 1973; 1963 act was Mysore Official Language Act, not Karnataka.
